quests.name: seed-42
quests.rules:
# Office game rules: every number the game uses lives here.
# Change them between weeks: `office.py reset`, edit, `office.py setup`.

[office]
seat_prefix = "game-"      # key alias = prefix + name, so game seats
                           # never clash with your real ones
models = ["local", "pro"]  # models a game key may use
key_life = "8d"            # game keys expire after this (a week+)

[day]
# One game day. It is also each key's budget_duration, so LiteLLM
# itself refills the mana. LiteLLM lines resets up with the clock
# ("2m" refills at :00, :02, :04...), so pick a length that splits
# the hour (or the day) evenly. Practice: "2m". Real office: "1d".
length = "2m"
# Bots stop this long before the day ends, so the spend logs are
# written and scored before the mana resets.
close = "35s"
per_week = 5

[mana]
usd = 0.00001  # 1 mana = this many US dollars of model spend
daily = 1500   # mana per seat per day: the key's max_budget

[quests]
per_seat = 10     # quests posted per seat per day (enough that the
                  # fastest bots never run out)
redo_share = 0.5  # a rejected quest needs this share of its calls again
max_attempts = 3  # rejected this many times: given up

# value: points at par. calls: the fewest tagged requests that prove
# the work was done (min_calls). par_mana: what the work should cost.
# weight: how often this size is posted.
[quests.sizes.small]
weight = 5
value = 10
calls = 2
par_mana = 12

[quests.sizes.medium]
weight = 3
value = 25
calls = 4
par_mana = 25

[quests.sizes.large]
weight = 2
value = 50
calls = 7
par_mana = 45

[score]
eff_min = 0.33      # efficiency = par_mana / mana used, kept in
eff_max = 1.5       # this range (the floor is hit at 3x par)
streak_step = 0.10  # +10% for each day in a row with an approved quest
streak_cap = 0.50   # up to +50%. Only days before today count, so a
                    # 5-day week tops out at +40%
flush_wait = "60s"  # most time to wait for spend logs at day end

[board]
individuals = true  # false: show only guilds (kinder in a real office)

[sim]
seed = 42         # same seed, same dice (timing still varies)
pro_boost = 0.15  # extra approval chance for work done on pro

# Personas: how each bot works.
#   pro      chance a quest is done on the pro model
#   chars    prompt size range, in characters (4 chars ~ 1 token)
#   reply    max_tokens asked for
#   per_step calls per step of work
#   retry    chance to resend a step anyway
#   skill    chance the manager approves the work
#   pause    seconds between calls. frugal, balanced and gearhead
#            share one pace, so only their AI habits differ
#   quests   most quests per day
#   bluff    chance to hand a quest in after one call
#   stream   ask for streamed replies

[personas.frugal]
pro = 0.0
chars = [300, 700]
reply = 80
per_step = 1
retry = 0.0
skill = 0.80
pause = [1.0, 2.0]
quests = 99
bluff = 0.0
stream = false

[personas.balanced]
pro = 0.25
chars = [600, 1400]
reply = 160
per_step = 1
retry = 0.05
skill = 0.80
pause = [1.0, 2.0]
quests = 99
bluff = 0.0
stream = true

[personas.spammy]
pro = 0.1
chars = [3000, 8000]
reply = 400
per_step = 2
retry = 0.3
skill = 0.60
pause = [0.2, 0.6]
quests = 99
bluff = 0.0
stream = false

[personas.gearhead]
pro = 1.0
chars = [600, 1400]
reply = 200
per_step = 1
retry = 0.05
skill = 0.80
pause = [1.0, 2.0]
quests = 99
bluff = 0.0
stream = false

[personas.slacker]
pro = 0.0
chars = [300, 800]
reply = 100
per_step = 1
retry = 0.0
skill = 0.70
pause = [3.0, 6.0]
quests = 2
bluff = 0.5
stream = false

# The office: who plays, how, and in which guild.
# Names: up to 6 lowercase letters or digits.
[roster]
seats = [
  {name = "fern",  persona = "frugal",   guild = "owls"},
  {name = "bea",   persona = "balanced", guild = "owls"},
  {name = "gus",   persona = "gearhead", guild = "owls"},
  {name = "sid",   persona = "slacker",  guild = "owls"},
  {name = "moss",  persona = "frugal",   guild = "foxes"},
  {name = "spike", persona = "spammy",   guild = "foxes"},
  {name = "sal",   persona = "slacker",  guild = "foxes"},
  {name = "ben",   persona = "balanced", guild = "bees"},
  {name = "blitz", persona = "spammy",   guild = "bees"},
  {name = "gia",   persona = "gearhead", guild = "bees"},
]

bots.name: frugal-down
bots.rules:
# Office game rules: every number the game uses lives here.
# Change them between weeks: `office.py reset`, edit, `office.py setup`.

[office]
seat_prefix = "game-"      # key alias = prefix + name, so game seats
                           # never clash with your real ones
models = ["local", "pro"]  # models a game key may use
key_life = "8d"            # game keys expire after this (a week+)

[day]
# One game day. It is also each key's budget_duration, so LiteLLM
# itself refills the mana. LiteLLM lines resets up with the clock
# ("2m" refills at :00, :02, :04...), so pick a length that splits
# the hour (or the day) evenly. Practice: "2m". Real office: "1d".
length = "2m"
# Bots stop this long before the day ends, so the spend logs are
# written and scored before the mana resets.
close = "35s"
per_week = 5

[mana]
usd = 0.00001  # 1 mana = this many US dollars of model spend
daily = 1500   # mana per seat per day: the key's max_budget

[quests]
per_seat = 10     # quests posted per seat per day (enough that the
                  # fastest bots never run out)
redo_share = 0.5  # a rejected quest needs this share of its calls again
max_attempts = 3  # rejected this many times: given up

# value: points at par. calls: the fewest tagged requests that prove
# the work was done (min_calls). par_mana: what the work should cost.
# weight: how often this size is posted.
[quests.sizes.small]
weight = 5
value = 10
calls = 2
par_mana = 12

[quests.sizes.medium]
weight = 3
value = 25
calls = 4
par_mana = 25

[quests.sizes.large]
weight = 2
value = 50
calls = 7
par_mana = 45

[score]
eff_min = 0.33      # efficiency = par_mana / mana used, kept in
eff_max = 1.5       # this range (the floor is hit at 3x par)
streak_step = 0.10  # +10% for each day in a row with an approved quest
streak_cap = 0.50   # up to +50%. Only days before today count, so a
                    # 5-day week tops out at +40%
flush_wait = "60s"  # most time to wait for spend logs at day end

[board]
individuals = true  # false: show only guilds (kinder in a real office)

[sim]
seed = 42         # same seed, same dice (timing still varies)
pro_boost = 0.15  # extra approval chance for work done on pro

# Personas: how each bot works.
#   pro      chance a quest is done on the pro model
#   chars    prompt size range, in characters (4 chars ~ 1 token)
#   reply    max_tokens asked for
#   per_step calls per step of work
#   retry    chance to resend a step anyway
#   skill    chance the manager approves the work
#   pause    seconds between calls. frugal, balanced and gearhead
#            share one pace, so only their AI habits differ
#   quests   most quests per day
#   bluff    chance to hand a quest in after one call
#   stream   ask for streamed replies

[personas.frugal]
pro = 0.0
chars = [300, 700]
reply = 80
per_step = 1
retry = 0.0
skill = 0.80
pause = [1.0, 2.0]
quests = 99
bluff = 0.0
stream = false

[personas.balanced]
pro = 0.25
chars = [600, 1400]
reply = 160
per_step = 1
retry = 0.05
skill = 0.80
pause = [1.0, 2.0]
quests = 99
bluff = 0.0
stream = true

[personas.spammy]
pro = 0.1
chars = [3000, 8000]
reply = 400
per_step = 2
retry = 0.3
skill = 0.60
pause = [0.2, 0.6]
quests = 99
bluff = 0.0
stream = false

[personas.gearhead]
pro = 1.0
chars = [600, 1400]
reply = 200
per_step = 1
retry = 0.05
skill = 0.80
pause = [1.0, 2.0]
quests = 99
bluff = 0.0
stream = false

[personas.slacker]
pro = 0.0
chars = [300, 800]
reply = 100
per_step = 1
retry = 0.0
skill = 0.70
pause = [3.0, 6.0]

bots.name: gearhead-late
bots.rules:
# Office game rules: every number the game uses lives here.
# Change them between weeks: `office.py reset`, edit, `office.py setup`.

[office]
seat_prefix = "game-"      # key alias = prefix + name, so game seats
                           # never clash with your real ones
models = ["local", "pro"]  # models a game key may use
key_life = "8d"            # game keys expire after this (a week+)

[day]
# One game day. It is also each key's budget_duration, so LiteLLM
# itself refills the mana. LiteLLM lines resets up with the clock
# ("2m" refills at :00, :02, :04...), so pick a length that splits
# the hour (or the day) evenly. Practice: "2m". Real office: "1d".
length = "2m"
# Bots stop this long before the day ends, so the spend logs are
# written and scored before the mana resets.
close = "35s"
per_week = 5

[mana]
usd = 0.00001  # 1 mana = this many US dollars of model spend
daily = 1500   # mana per seat per day: the key's max_budget

[quests]
per_seat = 10     # quests posted per seat per day (enough that the
                  # fastest bots never run out)
redo_share = 0.5  # a rejected quest needs this share of its calls again
max_attempts = 3  # rejected this many times: given up

# value: points at par. calls: the fewest tagged requests that prove
# the work was done (min_calls). par_mana: what the work should cost.
# weight: how often this size is posted.
[quests.sizes.small]
weight = 5
value = 10
calls = 2
par_mana = 12

[quests.sizes.medium]
weight = 3
value = 25
calls = 4
par_mana = 25

[quests.sizes.large]
weight = 2
value = 50
calls = 7
par_mana = 45

[score]
eff_min = 0.33      # efficiency = par_mana / mana used, kept in
eff_max = 1.5       # this range (the floor is hit at 3x par)
streak_step = 0.10  # +10% for each day in a row with an approved quest
streak_cap = 0.50   # up to +50%. Only days before today count, so a
                    # 5-day week tops out at +40%
flush_wait = "60s"  # most time to wait for spend logs at day end

[board]
individuals = true  # false: show only guilds (kinder in a real office)

[sim]
seed = 42         # same seed, same dice (timing still varies)
pro_boost = 0.15  # extra approval chance for work done on pro

# Personas: how each bot works.
#   pro      chance a quest is done on the pro model
#   chars    prompt size range, in characters (4 chars ~ 1 token)
#   reply    max_tokens asked for
#   per_step calls per step of work
#   retry    chance to resend a step anyway
#   skill    chance the manager approves the work
#   pause    seconds between calls. frugal, balanced and gearhead
#            share one pace, so only their AI habits differ
#   quests   most quests per day
#   bluff    chance to hand a quest in after one call
#   stream   ask for streamed replies

[personas.frugal]
pro = 0.0
chars = [300, 700]
reply = 80
per_step = 1
retry = 0.0
skill = 0.80
pause = [1.0, 2.0]
quests = 99
bluff = 0.0
stream = false

[personas.balanced]
pro = 0.25
chars = [600, 1400]
reply = 160
per_step = 1
retry = 0.05
skill = 0.80
pause = [1.0, 2.0]
quests = 99
bluff = 0.0
stream = true

[personas.spammy]
pro = 0.1
chars = [3000, 8000]
reply = 400
per_step = 2
retry = 0.3
skill = 0.60
pause = [0.2, 0.6]
quests = 99
bluff = 0.0
stream = false

[personas.gearhead]
pro = 1.0
chars = [600, 1400]
reply = 200
per_step = 1
retry = 0.05
skill = 0.80
pause = [1.0, 2.0]
quests = 99
bluff = 0.0
stream = false

[personas.slacker]
pro = 0.0
chars = [300, 800]
reply = 100
per_step = 1
retry = 0.0
skill = 0.70
pause = [3.0, 6.0]
quests = 2
bluff = 0.5
stream = false

# The office: who plays, how, and in which guild.
# Names: up to 6 lowercase letters or digits.
[roster]
seats = [
  {name = "fern",  persona = "frugal",   guild = "owls"},
  {name = "bea",   persona = "balanced", guild = "owls"},
  {name = "gus",   persona = "gearhead", guild = "owls"},

  {name = "sal",   persona = "slacker",  guild = "foxes"},
  {name = "ben",   persona = "balanced", guild = "bees"},
  {name = "blitz", persona = "spammy",   guild = "bees"},

]

waits.name: fresh
waits.rules:
# Office game rules: every number the game uses lives here.
# Change them between weeks: `office.py reset`, edit, `office.py setup`.

[office]
seat_prefix = "game-"      # key alias = prefix + name, so game seats
                           # never clash with your real ones
models = ["local", "pro"]  # models a game key may use
key_life = "8d"            # game keys expire after this (a week+)

[day]
# One game day. It is also each key's budget_duration, so LiteLLM
# itself refills the mana. LiteLLM lines resets up with the clock
# ("2m" refills at :00, :02, :04...), so pick a length that splits
# the hour (or the day) evenly. Practice: "2m". Real office: "1d".
length = "2m"
# Bots stop this long before the day ends, so the spend logs are
# written and scored before the mana resets.
close = "35s"
per_week = 5

[mana]
usd = 0.00001  # 1 mana = this many US dollars of model spend
daily = 1500   # mana per seat per day: the key's max_budget

[quests]
per_seat = 10     # quests posted per seat per day (enough that the
                  # fastest bots never run out)
redo_share = 0.5  # a rejected quest needs this share of its calls again
max_attempts = 3  # rejected this many times: given up

# value: points at par. calls: the fewest tagged requests that prove
# the work was done (min_calls). par_mana: what the work should cost.
# weight: how often this size is posted.
[quests.sizes.small]
weight = 5
value = 10
calls = 2
par_mana = 12

[quests.sizes.medium]
weight = 3
value = 25
calls = 4
par_mana = 25

[quests.sizes.large]
weight = 2
value = 50
calls = 7
par_mana = 45

[score]
eff_min = 0.33      # efficiency = par_mana / mana used, kept in
eff_max = 1.5       # this range (the floor is hit at 3x par)
streak_step = 0.10  # +10% for each day in a row with an approved quest
streak_cap = 0.50   # up to +50%. Only days before today count, so a
                    # 5-day week tops out at +40%
flush_wait = "60s"  # most time to wait for spend logs at day end

[board]
individuals = true  # false: show only guilds (kinder in a real office)

[sim]
seed = 42         # same seed, same dice (timing still varies)
pro_boost = 0.15  # extra approval chance for work done on pro

# Personas: how each bot works.
#   pro      chance a quest is done on the pro model
#   chars    prompt size range, in characters (4 chars ~ 1 token)
#   reply    max_tokens asked for
#   per_step calls per step of work
#   retry    chance to resend a step anyway
#   skill    chance the manager approves the work
#   pause    seconds between calls. frugal, balanced and gearhead
#            share one pace, so only their AI habits differ
#   quests   most quests per day
#   bluff    chance to hand a quest in after one call
#   stream   ask for streamed replies

[personas.frugal]
pro = 0.0
chars = [300, 700]
reply = 80
per_step = 1
retry = 0.0
skill = 0.80
pause = [1.0, 2.0]
quests = 99
bluff = 0.0
stream = false

[personas.balanced]
pro = 0.25
chars = [600, 1400]
reply = 160
per_step = 1
retry = 0.05
skill = 0.80
pause = [1.0, 2.0]
quests = 99
bluff = 0.0
stream = true

[personas.spammy]
pro = 0.1
chars = [3000, 8000]
reply = 400
per_step = 2
retry = 0.3
skill = 0.60
pause = [0.2, 0.6]
quests = 99
bluff = 0.0
stream = false

[personas.gearhead]
pro = 1.0
chars = [600, 1400]
reply = 200
per_step = 1
retry = 0.05
skill = 0.80
pause = [1.0, 2.0]
quests = 99
bluff = 0.0
stream = false

[personas.slacker]
pro = 0.0
chars = [300, 800]
reply = 100
per_step = 1
retry = 0.0
skill = 0.70
pause = [3.0, 6.0]
quests = 2
bluff = 0.5
stream = false

# The office: who plays, how, and in which guild.
# Names: up to 6 lowercase letters or digits.
[roster]
seats = [{name = "bea", persona = "balanced", guild = "owls"}, {name = "ben", persona = "balanced", guild = "bees"}, {name = "blitz", persona = "spammy", guild = "bees"}]

[mana]

# Office game rules: every number the game uses lives here.
# Change them between weeks: `office.py reset`, edit, `office.py setup`.

[office]
seat_prefix = "game-"      # key alias = prefix + name, so game seats
                           # never clash with your real ones
models = ["local", "pro"]  # models a game key may use
key_life = "8d"            # game keys expire after this (a week+)

[day]
# One game day. It is also each key's budget_duration, so LiteLLM
# itself refills the mana. LiteLLM lines resets up with the clock
# ("2m" refills at :00, :02, :04...), so pick a length that splits
# the hour (or the day) evenly. Practice: "2m". Real office: "1d".
length = "2m"
# Bots stop this long before the day ends, so the spend logs are
# written and scored before the mana resets.
close = "35s"
per_week = 5

[mana]
usd = 0.00001  # 1 mana = this many US dollars of model spend
daily = 1500   # mana per seat per day: the key's max_budget

[quests]
per_seat = 10     # quests posted per seat per day (enough that the
                  # fastest bots never run out)
redo_share = 0.5  # a rejected quest needs this share of its calls again
max_attempts = 3  # rejected this many times: given up

# value: points at par. calls: the fewest tagged requests that prove
# the work was done (min_calls). par_mana: what the work should cost.
# weight: how often this size is posted.
[quests.sizes.small]
weight = 5
value = 10
calls = 2
par_mana = 12

[quests.sizes.medium]
weight = 3
value = 25
calls = 4
par_mana = 25

[quests.sizes.large]
weight = 2
value = 50
calls = 7
par_mana = 45

[score]
eff_min = 0.33      # efficiency = par_mana / mana used, kept in
eff_max = 1.5       # this range (the floor is hit at 3x par)
streak_step = 0.10  # +10% for each day in a row with an approved quest
streak_cap = 0.50   # up to +50%. Only days before today count, so a
                    # 5-day week tops out at +40%
flush_wait = "60s"  # most time to wait for spend logs at day end

[board]
individuals = true  # false: show only guilds (kinder in a real office)

[sim]
seed = 42         # same seed, same dice (timing still varies)
pro_boost = 0.15  # extra approval chance for work done on pro

# Personas: how each bot works.
#   pro      chance a quest is done on the pro model
#   chars    prompt size range, in characters (4 chars ~ 1 token)
#   reply    max_tokens asked for
#   per_step calls per step of work
#   retry    chance to resend a step anyway
#   skill    chance the manager approves the work
#   pause    seconds between calls. frugal, balanced and gearhead
#            share one pace, so only their AI habits differ
#   quests   most quests per day
#   bluff    chance to hand a quest in after one call
#   stream   ask for streamed replies

[personas.frugal]
pro = 0.0
chars = [300, 700]
reply = 80
per_step = 1
retry = 0.0
skill = 0.80
pause = [1.0, 2.0]
quests = 99
bluff = 0.0
stream = false

[personas.balanced]
pro = 0.25
chars = [600, 1400]
reply = 160
per_step = 1
retry = 0.05
skill = 0.80
pause = [1.0, 2.0]
quests = 99
bluff = 0.0
stream = true

[personas.spammy]
pro = 0.1
chars = [3000, 8000]
reply = 400
per_step = 2
retry = 0.3
skill = 0.60
pause = [0.2, 0.6]
quests = 99
bluff = 0.0
stream = false

[personas.gearhead]
pro = 1.0
chars = [600, 1400]
reply = 200
per_step = 1
retry = 0.05
skill = 0.80
pause = [1.0, 2.0]
quests = 99
bluff = 0.0
stream = false

[personas.slacker]
pro = 0.0
chars = [300, 800]
reply = 100
per_step = 1
retry = 0.0
skill = 0.70
pause = [3.0, 6.0]
quests = 2
bluff = 0.5
stream = false

# The office: who plays, how, and in which guild.
# Names: up to 6 lowercase letters or digits.
[roster]
seats = [{name = "bea", persona = "balanced", guild = "owls"}, {name = "ben", persona = "balanced", guild = "bees"}, {name = "blitz", persona = "spammy", guild = "bees"}]

# Office game rules: every number the game uses lives here.
# Change them between weeks: `office.py reset`, edit, `office.py setup`.

[office]
seat_prefix = "game-"      # key alias = prefix + name, so game seats
                           # never clash with your real ones
models = ["local", "pro"]  # models a game key may use
key_life = "8d"            # game keys expire after this (a week+)

[day]
# One game day. It is also each key's budget_duration, so LiteLLM
# itself refills the mana. LiteLLM lines resets up with the clock
# ("2m" refills at :00, :02, :04...), so pick a length that splits
# the hour (or the day) evenly. Practice: "2m". Real office: "1d".
length = "2m"
# Bots stop this long before the day ends, so the spend logs are
# written and scored before the mana resets.
close = "35s"
per_week = 5

[mana]
usd = 0.00001  # 1 mana = this many US dollars of model spend
daily = 1500   # mana per seat per day: the key's max_budget

[quests]
per_seat = 10     # quests posted per seat per day (enough that the
                  # fastest bots never run out)
redo_share = 0.5  # a rejected quest needs this share of its calls again
max_attempts = 3  # rejected this many times: given up

# value: points at par. calls: the fewest tagged requests that prove
# the work was done (min_calls). par_mana: what the work should cost.
# weight: how often this size is posted.
[quests.sizes.small]
weight = 5
value = 10
calls = 2
par_mana = 12

[quests.sizes.medium]
weight = 3
value = 25
calls = 4
par_mana = 25

[quests.sizes.large]
weight = 2
value = 50
calls = 7
par_mana = 45

[score]
eff_min = 0.33      # efficiency = par_mana / mana used, kept in
eff_max = 1.5       # this range (the floor is hit at 3x par)
streak_step = 0.10  # +10% for each day in a row with an approved quest
streak_cap = 0.50   # up to +50%. Only days before today count, so a
                    # 5-day week tops out at +40%
flush_wait = "60s"  # most time to wait for spend logs at day end

[board]
individuals = true  # false: show only guilds (kinder in a real office)

[sim]
seed = 42         # same seed, same dice (timing still varies)
pro_boost = 0.15  # extra approval chance for work done on pro

# Personas: how each bot works.
#   pro      chance a quest is done on the pro model
#   chars    prompt size range, in characters (4 chars ~ 1 token)
#   reply    max_tokens asked for
#   per_step calls per step of work
#   retry    chance to resend a step anyway
#   skill    chance the manager approves the work
#   pause    seconds between calls. frugal, balanced and gearhead
#            share one pace, so only their AI habits differ
#   quests   most quests per day
#   bluff    chance to hand a quest in after one call
#   stream   ask for streamed replies

[personas.frugal]
pro = 0.0
chars = [300, 700]
reply = 80
per_step = 1
retry = 0.0
skill = 0.80
pause = [1.0, 2.0]
quests = 99
bluff = 0.0
stream = false

[personas.balanced]
pro = 0.25
chars = [600, 1400]
reply = 160
per_step = 1
retry = 0.05
skill = 0.80
pause = [1.0, 2.0]
quests = 99
bluff = 0.0
stream = true

[personas.spammy]
pro = 0.1
chars = [3000, 8000]
reply = 400
per_step = 2
retry = 0.3
skill = 0.60
pause = [0.2, 0.6]
quests = 99
bluff = 0.0
stream = false

[personas.gearhead]
pro = 1.0
chars = [600, 1400]
reply = 200
per_step = 1
retry = 0.05
skill = 0.80
pause = [1.0, 2.0]
quests = 99
bluff = 0.0
stream = false

[personas.slacker]
pro = 0.0
chars = [300, 800]
reply = 100
per_step = 1
retry = 0.0
skill = 0.70
pause = [3.0, 6.0]
quests = 2
bluff = 0.5
stream = false

# The office: who plays, how, and in which guild.
# Names: up to 6 lowercase letters or digits.
[roster]
seats = [{name = "bea", persona = "balanced", guild = "owls"}, {name = "ben", persona = "balanced", guild = "bees"}, {name = "blitz", persona = "spammy", guild = "bees"}]
